oci_network_infrastructure_011.display_name: OCI-NETWORK-INFRASTRUCTURE-011: CVE-2026-20349 — Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)  Exploitation
oci_network_infrastructure_011.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-20349: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) contain a heap inspection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.. Product: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)
